data.name: Hibbah
data.gender_notes: Hibbah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-b-b' meaning 'to love'. In Islamic context, Hibbah refers to the deep affection, kindness, and compassion shown to others. The name Hibbah carries the meaning “Love, affection, kindness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hibbah usually hope their child will grow to embody love, affection, kindness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the Prophet's (PBUH) love and compassion towards his followers.
data.etymology: Hibbah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Love, affection, kindness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hibbah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
